text: For each department, list the department name together with the number of employees whose salary is above the median salary of that department, ordered by that count descending.
A report joins orders (2.4 million rows) with customers (5,200 rows) filtering on order_date. Assess a composite, a covering and a partial index, and recommend one with justification.

Given the interleaved schedule S over T1, T2 and T3, determine whether S is conflict serialisable, then evaluate whether strict two-phase locking or timestamp ordering would have prevented the anomaly.
Given R(A,B,C,D,E,F) with F = {A->BC, CD->EF, B->D}, compute the attribute closure of A and determine every candidate key. Show your working.
Two designers propose different ER models for the same requirement. Compare them on redundancy, extensibility and query cost, and recommend one.
Explain why a dirty read can occur under read-uncommitted isolation, and give a concrete two-transaction schedule that demonstrates it.
